identity_reason: a box has no shape of its own; it only carries padding and a corner from the scales
concept: Padding and a corner from the scales and nothing else, so layout never invents a look and glass stays with Card.

root.why: a box that only holds padding and a corner, so a Card stays the one thing with a look

p-none.why: padding on every side from the gap scale (none)

pi-none.why: inline padding from the gap scale (none) wherever the component is used in a screen

pb-none.why: block padding from the gap scale (none) wherever the component is used in a screen

p-xs.why: padding on every side from the gap scale (xs)

pi-xs.why: inline padding from the gap scale (xs) wherever the component is used in a screen

pb-xs.why: block padding from the gap scale (xs) wherever the component is used in a screen

p-sm.why: padding on every side from the gap scale (sm)

pi-sm.why: inline padding from the gap scale (sm) wherever the component is used in a screen

pb-sm.why: block padding from the gap scale (sm) wherever the component is used in a screen

p-md.why: padding on every side from the gap scale (md)

pi-md.why: inline padding from the gap scale (md) wherever the component is used in a screen

pb-md.why: block padding from the gap scale (md) wherever the component is used in a screen

p-lg.why: padding on every side from the gap scale (lg)

pi-lg.why: inline padding from the gap scale (lg) wherever the component is used in a screen

pb-lg.why: block padding from the gap scale (lg) wherever the component is used in a screen

p-xl.why: padding on every side from the gap scale (xl)

pi-xl.why: inline padding from the gap scale (xl) wherever the component is used in a screen

pb-xl.why: block padding from the gap scale (xl) wherever the component is used in a screen

p-2xl.why: padding on every side from the gap scale (2xl)

pi-2xl.why: inline padding from the gap scale (2xl) wherever the component is used in a screen

pb-2xl.why: block padding from the gap scale (2xl) wherever the component is used in a screen

r-none.why: the none corner from the shape scale, so a box nested in a pane can follow its curve

r-inner.why: the inner corner from the shape scale, so a box nested in a pane can follow its curve

r-media.why: the media corner from the shape scale, so a box nested in a pane can follow its curve

r-round.why: the round corner from the shape scale, so a box nested in a pane can follow its curve
